tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and terminal background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, the terminal frame, inputs.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers only; decorative, not a control edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and quiet-button borders; 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, prompts, unchanged file names; on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Bytes in flight: the progress fill, the one primary action, links. As text, on surface, surface-raised or accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Progress track; ground behind accent text and the synced badge.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an accent fill (the primary button's label).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed transfer, destructive confirm; as text on surface, surface-raised or danger-soft. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text and the failed badge.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Conflicts, stale peers, dry-run notices; as text on surface, surface-raised or warn-soft.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warn text and the conflict badge.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in prose and docs; an alias of accent.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace
families.sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Prose
groups.note: Docs and UI copy. System sans; no font files ship yet.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Sync a folder to a peer

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Only the chunks that changed travel, straight from one peer to the other.

groups.name: Terminal
groups.note: Commands, paths, ids, numbers, status. Tabular by nature.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, paths, node ids, sizes and rates; inline code in prose.

styles.name: code-small
styles.usage: Dense terminal output and table cells.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-label gap; progress bar height.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between rows of output; inside badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button and input horizontal padding; between a row's columns.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and terminal-frame padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Control height; page gutters.

radius.note: Nearly square. No pills, no circles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, progress bars, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The terminal frame only.

shadow.note: Flat. One shadow for floating surfaces, and the focus ring.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Popovers and menus; nothing at rest.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px page-colour gap, then 2px of solid accent (box-shadow, so it follows the radius).
